contents.name: Theorem 3.1: Euclidean state distance controls observed distributions
contents.detail: The source gives a looser total-variation estimate; the local state-gap lemma proves its exact 1/6 constant directly from the acceptance projection.

contents.name: Definition 3.2: query magnitude at a string
contents.detail: The address probability is represented by the local orthogonal projectors; the indexing convention is explicitly translated to zero-based address i−1. The locally proved QA14 carrier is def-qa-14-query-mismatch-projectors.

contents.name: Theorem 3.3: query-replacement hybrid estimate
contents.detail: The local proof specializes the source perturbation idea to the standard XOR bit oracle by computing its address-i block difference. The locally proved QA14 carrier is lem-qa-14-one-query-hybrid-bound.

contents.name: Corollary 3.4: only a small set of strings has large cumulative query magnitude
contents.reason: This cardinality corollary is for oracle strings in the source setting; QA14 instead proves the finite singleton aggregate squared-distance inequality directly by Cauchy–Schwarz.
contents.detail: undefined The locally proved QA14 carrier is lem-qa-14-aggregate-hybrid-squared-distance.

contents.name: Theorem 3.5: random-oracle separation of BQTime from NP
contents.reason: This is a random-oracle complexity-class theorem, not the finite empty-versus-one-marked search lower bound required by QA14; the local BBBV argument is proved separately.

contents.name: §7.1: unstructured-search promise and output task
contents.detail: The local promise extends the dyadic presentation to every N≥1 and explicitly identifies OR, marked-coordinate output, and verification. The locally proved QA14 carrier is def-qa-14-search-promise.

contents.name: §7.2: Grover invariant-plane rotation and rounded integer iteration
contents.detail: The QA11 exact rotation/regime and local rational-recurrence identity prove the success statement; the empty input is handled by candidate verification. The locally proved QA14 carrier is thm-qa-14-grover-search-upper-success.

contents.name: §11.1: standard XOR query model
contents.detail: The local definition records the N-level address convention, zero-based address j, and input coordinate x_(j+1) explicitly. The locally proved QA14 carrier is def-qa-14-boolean-search-query-model.

contents.name: §11.2: polynomial method and OR approximate-degree lower bound
contents.reason: The polynomial method is outside the design scope, which calls for the local BBBV hybrid proof; no polynomial-method lower bound is used or claimed.

contents.name: §11.3: adversary lower bound and OR example
contents.detail: This provides a separate lower-bound treatment for the same asymptotic search task; the local proof follows the required BBBV route instead. The locally proved QA14 carrier is thm-qa-14-bbbv-search-lower-bound.

contents.detail: The source assumes positive initial success probability; QA14 uses the independent QA11 integer-regime theorem and proves the recurrence match locally. The locally proved QA14 carrier is thm-qa-14-grover-search-upper-success.

contents.detail: The fixed-one schedule is a local verified variant; zero completion for arbitrary N and the empty-input branch are established in separate local items. The locally proved QA14 carrier is alg-qa-14-one-marked-search-with-verification.
